name: obsidian-wise-view
description: Enriched Obsidian Bases views: Calendar, Kanban, and Gantt — task-management agnostic

scripts.lint: biome lint src scripts tests esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs package.json manifest.json biome.jsonc eslint.config.mts tsconfig.json --diagnostic-level=error
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src scripts tests esbuild.config.mjs version-bump.mjs package.json manifest.json biome.jsonc eslint.config.mts tsconfig.json
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:obsidian && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:artifacts
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
